name: Make Your Reading Routine Actually Stick
equipment: A book you are currently reading
instructions: Identify the specific moment your reading habit usually breaks down (a busy week, a boring chapter) and plan for it in advance.
Keep a backup book or format (an audiobook, a short story collection) for the days a long novel feels like too much.
Review your reading streak weekly rather than daily -- a single missed day matters less than the overall trend.
Watch today's video for why most reading routines fail and how to avoid it.
